mapper.select: SELECT id, feedback_source_id FROM t_sdk_ingest WHERE retention_until < NOW(3) AND ciphertext_deleted_at IS NULL AND ingest_status NOT IN ('PROCESSING', 'RETRY_PENDING', 'REVIEW_NEEDED') AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_sdk_ingest SET encrypted_data_key = NULL, payload_nonce = NULL, payload_ciphertext = NULL, payload_tag = NULL, contact_nonce = NULL, contact_ciphertext = NULL, contact_tag = NULL, ciphertext_deleted_at = NOW(3), disposition_reason = IF(disposition_status = 'OPEN', 'RETENTION_EXPIRED', disposition_reason), disposition_note = IF(disposition_status = 'OPEN', '原始密文到期清理，异常自动归档', disposition_note), disposition_at = IF(disposition_status = 'OPEN', NOW(3), disposition_at), disposition_status = IF(disposition_status = 'OPEN', 'AUTO_ARCHIVED', disposition_status) WHERE id IN #{id} AND retention_until < NOW(3) AND ciphertext_deleted_at IS NULL AND ingest_status NOT IN ('PROCESSING', 'RETRY_PENDING', 'REVIEW_NEEDED')
